description:
The festivals and vrats of a year for a place as an iCalendar file (`text/calendar`, RFC 5545): one all-day event per observance, the rule, tithi window, parana and source in the description, a stable UID per festival, date and place. Query: `year`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `timezone` (IANA or auto), `include` (festivals, vrats or single vrat types, comma separated; default festivals,vrats), `tradition`. The key travels in X-Api-Key, so fetch it from your server and serve the file to calendar apps; it is priced as one festivals call.

[Group: Vedic]
[Endpoint: GET /v1/vedic/calendar/ics]
[Required: year, latitude, longitude]
[Cost: 100 credits (Tier 4)]

include.description: Comma list: festivals, vrats, or single vrat types (ekadashi, pradosh, sankashti, purnima, amavasya, masik-shivaratri).

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, north positive.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, east positive.

timezone.description: IANA zone name, or auto to look it up from the coordinates. Followed day by day, summer time included.

tradition.description: Whose reckoning decides the day where traditions differ (Rama Navami, Janmashtami).

year.description: Gregorian year; events are those dated in it.

name: astroway_vedic_calendar_ics
title: Hindu calendar: ICS feed of festivals and vrats
